data.name: Faaqirun
data.long_meaning: Faaqirun is a title given to the Sufis who have renounced the world and dedicated their lives to God in search of spiritual enlightenment. They are considered as the poorest and most humble of God's creation.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes selflessness, detachment from worldly possessions, and deep devotion to God.

in_arabic.name: فاقرون
in_arabic.meaning: فقر و مفلسی سے بچنے والے لوگ
in_arabic.long_meaning: فاقرون (فقر) سے مشتق ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے فقر و مفلسی۔ یہ نام ان لوگوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو فقرو مفلسی سے بچتے ہیں اور اللہ کی رضا اور سخاوت پر بھروسہ کرتے ہیں۔ قرآن مجید میں اس جیسے الفاظ کا استعمال دیکھا گیا ہے، جیسے 'وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ' (طلاق: 2-3)، جس میں اللہ کی تقویٰ اور اس کی رحمت پر زور دیا گیا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: فقیرون
in_urdu.meaning: فقر و مفلسی سے بچنے والے لوگ
in_urdu.long_meaning: فقیرون کا نام عربی زبان کے لفظ 'فقر' سے لیا گیا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے فقر و مفلسی۔ یہ نام ان لوگوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو فقرو مفلسی سے بچتے ہیں اور اللہ کی رضا اور سخاوت پر بھروسہ کرتے ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلم tradition میں یہ نام احترام اور روحانیت کے ساتھ استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फ़ाकिरुन
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़ाकिरुन नाम का अर्थ है गरीबी से बचने वाले लोग। यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो गरीबी से बचते हैं और अल्लाह की कृपा और उदारता पर भरोसा करते हैं। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: فقیرون
in_pashto.long_meaning: فقیرون د (فقر) څخه مشتق شوی دی، چې معنی یې د فقر څخه بچیدل دي. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چې د فقر څخه بچي او د الله رضا او سخاوت باندې باور لري. په افغان او پښتني دود کې دا نوم د احترام او روحانيت سره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Faaqirun
in_english.long_meaning: The name Faaqirun is derived from the Arabic root 'faqr', which means 'poverty'. It refers to individuals who avoid poverty and rely on Allah's pleasure and generosity. This name has a significant spiritual connotation in Islamic tradition, reflecting a person's commitment to piety and trust in divine providence. Historically, the term 'faqir' has been used to describe Sufi ascetics who renounce worldly possessions. The name Faaqirun embodies virtues of humility, trust, and spiritual richness, making it a meaningful choice for Muslim parents.

data.cultural_impact: Faaqirun holds a significant cultural impact in Islamic societies, particularly in Sufi traditions. It represents a extreme form of piety and dedication to God. These individuals have renounced the materialistic world and live a simple, humble life. Their detachment from worldly possessions and pursuit of spiritual growth make them an inspiration for many in society. They serve as a reminder of the ultimate goal of human existence, which is pleasing Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Faaqirun holds deep spiritual significance as it refers to those individuals who have left behind the materialistic world and have devoted themselves to serving and connecting with God. In Islamic tradition, they are considered to be among the closest to Allah. The title "Faaqirun" itself means "the paupers" or "the poor" in Arabic. This is not just in terms of their material possessions, but also refers to their complete reliance on Allah and their spiritual poverty - recognizing their need for divine guidance and love. Their dedication and devotion serve as a model for other believers to strive for spiritual growth and connection with the Divine.
